scope: User-provided visual evidence for quote-6 terminal display and emulated narrow-screen rendering; independent from RPC proof.

assets.observed: Full quote-6 terminal screenshot: Expired, payment explicitly unavailable, complete service terms, original amounts and scheduler completion. Only Copy quote link is visible in the payment summary.
Narrow Quotes page top: navigation, connected merchant wallet ending 288E, explanatory text and New quote control fit the visible width.
Chrome Responsive toolbar explicitly shows 390 x 644. User scrolls quote cards, opens quote 6 with a terms fragment, scrolls terminal quote, and expands Contract details.

visualFindings: Quote cards and navigation are readable in the shown emulated viewport.
Quote 6 title and wallet addresses wrap; Expired and payment-blocked message are visible.
Payment summary stacks above service/payment terms, showing 0.0001 test ETH deposit, 0.0003 total and 0.0002 remaining; Copy quote link is visible.
No payment, approval or policy-retry control is visible for the expired quote.
Automation status shows completion, attempt 1 of 6, and funding caveats; Contract details expands with fingerprint wrapping and explorer link.
No obvious horizontal clipping appears in the reviewed screens; no DOM overflow measurement or physical-phone test was made.

consoleFindings.finding: MetaMask reports failure setting the global Ethereum provider because window.ethereum has only a getter; its message identifies another wallet extension as a likely cause.
consoleFindings.attribution: Message matches MetaMask provider-injection source; exact conflicting extension and complete cause not independently identified.

consoleFindings.finding: MaxListenersExceededWarning and ObjectMultiplex orphaned-data warnings reference content-script/inpage extension files.
consoleFindings.attribution: Observed only; not all warnings are conclusively attributed or resolved.
consoleFindings.status: OPEN: distinguish fresh warnings from old console history after a clean reload.

copyDefect.observed: Expired quote incorrectly labels its summary Deposit due today.
copyDefect.repair: For terminal or deadline-passed quotes the summary now says Deposit amount; only a still-payable awaiting-deposit quote says Deposit due today.
copyDefect.validation: Fresh web build recorded separately; post-repair user visual reproduction pending.

limits: Emulated Chrome viewport only; not a physical mobile wallet or complete mobile-browser compatibility test.
No approval/payment transaction, wallet signature, clipboard result, storage-denied browser case or continuous tab closure was demonstrated.
The recording does not show a build commit or configured deployment address; context and RPC proof are separate.
Raw user media is not published to the Git repository.
